# outbound_cloud_account (Resource)

A cloud account registered with Outbound. The API has no update, so every change replaces it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "outbound_onboarding" "aws" {
  cloud = "aws"
}

resource "aws_cloudformation_stack" "outbound" {
  name         = "outbound-onboarding"
  template_url = data.outbound_onboarding.aws.template_url
  capabilities = ["CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM"]

  parameters = {
    ExternalId           = data.outbound_onboarding.aws.external_id
    CloudPhilosAccountId = data.outbound_onboarding.aws.trusted_account_id
  }
}

resource "outbound_cloud_account" "this" {
  cloud        = "aws"
  account_name = "production"

  aws {
    account_id  = "123456789012"
    role_arn    = aws_cloudformation_stack.outbound.outputs["CloudPhilosNetworksRoleArn"]
    external_id = data.outbound_onboarding.aws.external_id
    regions     = ["eu-west-1"]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_name` (String) Display name in the Outbound UI.
- `cloud` (String) Cloud provider; only `aws` for now.

### Optional

- `aws` (Block, Optional) The AWS account and the role Outbound assumes. Required. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--aws))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The cloud account ID (for AWS, the account ID).

<a id="nestedblock--aws"></a>
### Nested Schema for `aws`

Required:

- `account_id` (String) AWS account ID.
- `external_id` (String) `data.outbound_onboarding.external_id`.
- `role_arn` (String) ARN of the role the onboarding stack creates.

Optional:

- `regions` (Set of String) Regions Outbound scans for VPCs.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The AWS account ID
terraform import outbound_cloud_account.this 123456789012
```
